highlights: Read and use the Distinguish left and right Ctrl checkbox when adding or replacing a keyboard shortcut, including in a compact Options window.
Inline Mermaid controls stay subtle until you point at the toolbar or focus a control.
Wide Mermaid diagrams fit the reading area when Markdown opens, even with a larger saved text size.
Closing a text file returns to the file pane or document that opened it, including after switching between Viewer and Editor.
